Graduation project · Grade: Excellent

DentIQ

An AI dental care app. Scan your teeth, get a diagnosis with a confidence score, and receive matching care tips.

What I did
  • Trained a dental-disease classifier (MobileNetV2) that reached 90%+ accuracy on the test set.
  • Built a daily care tracker, smart reminders, scan history and progress tracking with Cubit.
  • Integrated a Gemini-powered chatbot, plus authentication and profile management.

Home decor · Social

Decora

A social home decor app. Try designs on a real photo of your room and get personalized style suggestions.

What I did
  • Two-stage room analyzer: on-device dominant-color extraction, then Gemini API style and decor suggestions returned as structured results.
  • Wall Preview to test suggested palettes directly on a photo of your own room.
  • Real-time social chat with Firestore and Firebase Messaging for sharing designs with friends.

Education · Arabic RTL

Al-Waleed

The Al-Waleed chemistry platform app. Students get lessons, study notes, tests and live sessions.

What I did
  • Login with email and password accounts issued from the admin app, session handling, and a lessons module with video and PDF.
  • Lesson tests with progress tracking, results, wrong-answer review and retakes.
  • Live sessions via Zoom / Google Meet links, and a responsive Arabic RTL UI on Firebase.
  • Push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging to keep students updated.

Transit · Offline-first

Fleet Driver

A bus driver app for route tracking, live updates and fast free-seat logging, built to keep working without internet.

What I did
  • Route dashboard with live progress and GPS tracking, plus geofencing that unlocks seat logging only near the target station.
  • Offline-first logging: entries are cached in Hive first, and a background queue syncs them when the connection returns.
  • Live updates (congestion, delays, closures) from a simulated WebSocket service with heartbeat and auto-reconnect with exponential backoff.
3features: auth, route navigation, seat logging
